name: @chartmate/desktop
description: Chartmate desktop app (Electron): the Chartmate server and web UI in one hardened window, with no network listener.
author: Chartmate

scripts.pack:dir: pnpm --filter @chartmate/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @chartmate/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @chartmate/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
